# Traceability

How each requirement is designed, built and tested, following ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148 (requirement attributes,
two-way traces) and ISTQB (test basis ↔ test ↔ result). Edit the source docs, never these files: add a
trace in a doc's front matter (`traces:`) or a tag in a test (`{ tag: '@AC-AUTH-02' }`), then run
`npm run docs:build`.

- One matrix per feature (requirement → design → API → test), linked below.
- [tests.md](tests.md): the reverse view, test → requirement.
